title: docs(pm-dispatch): a card that touches cloud goes whole to the cloud PM
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb94MgYgf4gGRdZ3D5n9Qak9)_

No card: this implements the maintainer's direct instruction in a project thread (2026-10-27T14:12Z), verbatim: 「应该更新分诊和 skills，一个issue只要涉及 cloud ，就归 cloud pm 处理」. It follows the same maintainer's rule of 14:08Z the same day: 「cloud 相关的任务，转 cloud 车道处理」.

## What changes

Triage and the pm-dispatch skill now route any card that touches cloud to the cloud PM as ONE card, instead of splitting it by repository:

- **What "touches cloud" means:** the card needs cloud code read or changed, a cloud producer, a cloud fact (a reading only the cloud repo answers), or it carries a cloud half.
- **Who "the cloud PM" is:** the `repo:cloud` seat, posts #6026 (seat 1) and #24145 (seat 2). That seat's own scope already reads "the cloud repo's queue plus the cards on objectstack that carry `repo:cloud`", so the routing label is `repo:cloud`, with `domain:cloud` beside it.
- `SKILL.md` domain table: the `domain:cloud` row changes from "parked for the cloud PM to migrate" to this:
  - The whole card is the cloud PM's, and no objectstack lane claims it.
  - The cloud PM follows the card to closure.
  - Leftover objectstack-only work goes on a new card that states the cloud facts.
  - The row is 308 bytes, under its 341-byte pin.
- `references/cross-repo-coordination.md`:
  - The seam rule now says a seam that touches cloud goes to the cloud PM.
  - The four lines that split a cloud card by repository are replaced. The old lines kept the objectstack half in its lane and parked the cloud half with `domain:cloud` + `status:parked`. The new lines say:
    - An objectstack card gets `domain:cloud` + `repo:cloud` and a live pm state. Its lane `domain:*` comes off, and it never gets `status:parked`.
    - A card in another repo is transferred to cloud when it can be. Otherwise a `repo:cloud` carrier card here carries the whole ask.
    - The card is never split, and no lane waits on a cloud reading.
    - An in-flight card found to touch cloud is released (`Release:` + `pm:retriage`) so triage can re-route it. Measured read points stay on the card.
- `references/triage-duties.md`: the routing line says a cloud card is routed whole to the cloud lane.
- `references/execution-duties.md`: a report or review that finds cloud releases the card to triage. It is not split. A routed card carries no lane `domain:*`, so a lane's candidate query no longer returns it.
- `scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh`: the `domain:cloud` comment quotes the new ruling and says it supersedes the 2026-09-18 parking ruling. Both label descriptions say what the label now means and stay within the 100-character cap. `--reconcile` realigns the existing label objects; this PR writes no labels.

Every edited `.claude/` file stays at its line ceiling. Every prose line stays within the ratchet's 120-byte line budget. The text is replaced in place, so no line was added and no ceiling moves.

**One rule is dropped:** the split-by-repository rule for "any unreachable repository". Cloud is the only private repository the fleet cannot read. The general cross-repo rules in the same file still cover dependencies: a transfer lands in the target's queue with `Blocked-by:`, and a cross-seat request rides on an existing card.

## Why

Under the split rule, the objectstack half of a cloud card waits in a lane whose seats cannot read `objectstack-ai/cloud`. Two cards stalled that way on 2026-10-27:

- #25908 (ui): the card thread stopped twice because the `visualize_data` result shape after cloud#3292 could not be read from the ui lane. Its cloud half was then split to #26744 and parked.
- docs.objectos.ai#344 (docs, built from cloud code): it could not be dispatched from a seat without cloud access.

The cloud PM can read both repositories, so the card goes to it whole.

## Verification

Run in a fresh worktree after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, on head 4199852f. Exit codes were captured without pipes, and each gate exited 0:

- `check:pm-skill-ratchet` (the first head 9958e02d went red here on the 120-byte line budget; fixed in 4199852f)
- `check:pm-skill-id-lint`
- `check:pm-label-desc-cap`
- `check:doc-authoring`
- `check:pm-governed-prose`
- `check:skill-frame-sync`
- `check:skill-frame-freshness`
- `check:skill-identifier-liveness`
- `bash -n scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh`

No script reads `domain:cloud` (grep over `scripts/pm/`), so no reader changes behaviour. `status:parked` keeps its H13 exemption for any other parked card.

Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** 分诊与 pm-dispatch 技能:一张卡只要涉及 cloud(要读或改 cloud 代码、cloud 生产方、cloud 事实,或带 cloud 半边),就整卡交给 cloud PM(`repo:cloud` 席),挂 `domain:cloud`+`repo:cloud`,本仓各车道不认领,也不再拆半边停放。
- **为什么改:** 按您 10-27 的指示;旧规则把 cloud 卡按仓拆开,本仓那一半留在读不到 cloud 的车道里干等,#25908 和 docs#344 今天就这样卡住。
- **风险与回滚:** 只改 PM 规则文字和标签说明,不动产品代码;回滚即 revert 本 PR。cloud 席的工作量会变大,存量停放卡也归它。
- **先看:** `references/cross-repo-coordination.md` 末四行(新的路由规则)和 SKILL.md 的 `domain:cloud` 行。
- **两分钟验证:** 读 diff;四个技能文件行数都不变,每行都在 120 字节内。
- **需要你做的:** `.claude/**` 是 Tier S,需要一份合约档复核记录(PASS)才能落地,按项目规则等总监席;或者您直接批准合并。

## Not done here, on purpose

- **No `references/lanes/cloud.md`.** The cloud seat post notes that this charter is missing. A new file needs a new ceiling row, and that needs a ruling record id, so the cloud seat's scope stays in its post. A follow-up can add the charter.
- **No relabelling of existing cards** (#25908, #26744, other `domain:cloud` + `status:parked` cards). That is triage's work under the new rule once this lands.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (no names added)
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (no linted file touched)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset: nothing publishes, so `skip-changeset` applies.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: not touched.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the 维护者速读 section is the sanctioned Chinese channel).
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
